### Submission Checklist

Please verify before submitting:
- [ ] This product is an authentic, operational software application, SDK, or generative AI model.
- [ ] **Strictly No Directories or Aggregators:** This tool is NOT a directory, launch pad, curated list, or link farm.
- [ ] Working HTTPS landing page with clear pricing and documented features.
- [ ] The entry is added in **alphabetical order** under the appropriate category table in `README.md`.
- [ ] Follows the standard 5-column format:
  ```markdown
  | **[Tool Name](https://tool-url.com)** | Category | Pricing | Best For | [Directory Profile](https://www.needaitool.com) |
  ```
